site.name: Hellenic American Psychiatric Association
site.tagline: A Forum for Psychiatrists of Greek Origin
site.heroTitle: A professional home for psychiatrists of Greek origin.
site.heroLead: Founded in 1999, HAPA connects psychiatrists across the United States, Canada, Greece and the wider Greek diaspora — for scientific exchange, professional development, and advocacy for the mental health of Greek communities.

welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.author: Maria T. Lymberis, MD
paragraphs: As the Founder of HAPA I want to welcome you to our organization.
HAPA was founded on 15 May 1999 to fulfil an urgent need: to provide a PROFESSIONAL HOME for psychiatrists in the USA and in the GREEK DIASPORA.

The Hellenic psyche and its values are the unifying link of HAPA. Our membership is open to psychiatrists who are members of the American Psychiatric Association, the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry and the Hellenic Psychiatric Association — and to all professionals working in, or interested in, our field who share Hellenic roots or the passion for HELLENISM and HUMANISM.
HAPA always meets at the time of the APA Annual Meeting, on the Tuesday from 6:00 to 8:00 PM, followed by a Dutch-treat dinner at a local restaurant.
I hope you will look at our website, join us, and participate with your ideas and views.

mission: The mission of HAPA is to provide a forum for psychiatrists of Greek origin, or those who are Greek identified, to share experiences, establish a network for scientific and social exchange, facilitate the professional development and professional aspirations of members, and advocate for the psychiatric needs of Greek individuals, families and communities through education, research and professional organizational cooperation.
goalsIntro: HAPA is organized exclusively for educational, scientific and charitable purposes in the public interest. Our goals are:

goals.text: To promote professional affiliation through the continued study and exploration of the Hellenic heritage among Greek or Greek-identified psychiatrists who practise in the USA, Canada, Greece and other countries all over the world.
To promote a close cooperative relationship and professional exchange with other organizations concerned with psychiatric and psychotherapeutic education, research and treatment.
To identify and advocate for the psychiatric and psychotherapeutic needs of Greek communities.
To educate Greek communities on mental health issues and promote mental health services for Greek individuals, families and communities.

To recognize and publicize — and to establish funds and awards for — outstanding service, achievement or scientific contributions in the field of psychiatry, psychotherapy and psychoanalysis by Greek or Greek-identified psychiatrists.
To advocate for the special needs of psychiatrists of Greek origin.

To publish journals, newsletters, books or pamphlets, hold property, receive grants and awards, monitor research activities conducted under its auspices, and organize courses of instruction in areas of psychiatry and psychotherapy.

To make distributions to organizations that qualify as exempt organizations under Section 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, or the corresponding provision of any future United States Internal Revenue Law.

membership.intro: Becoming a member of HAPA is straightforward: complete the membership form and pay your dues online.
benefits: Receive the HAPA Newsletter by mail or e-mail
Contribute to the HAPA Newsletter and website
Join us in fulfilling our goals
Participate, network and exchange information with fellow Hellenophiles committed to psychiatric issues
Stand for HAPA committees and office
membership.duesNote: Annual membership dues can be paid online with any major credit card via PayPal. Choose your membership type and you will be taken to a secure PayPal page.
membership.postalNote: If you prefer to join by mail, download the sign-up form, complete it and post it with a cheque for your dues to the Chair of the Membership Committee. Forms may also be sent by fax.

news.title: The Journal of the American Academy of Psychiatry and the Law — Philip J. Candilis, MD: Biography
news.summary: A biography of HAPA President-Elect Philip J. Candilis published in JAAPL, recalling a first meeting in Denver during the historic AAPL blizzard.
news.body: The Journal of the American Academy of Psychiatry and the Law has published a biography of Philip J. Candilis, MD, DFAPA — HAPA President-Elect and Immediate Past President. The piece traces a career in forensic psychiatry, medical ethics and professional education, from Massachusetts to Saint Elizabeths Hospital in Washington, DC.

news.title: Annual HAPA Meeting, held in conjunction with the 2025 APA Meeting
news.summary: Dear HAPA members — you are cordially invited to attend our Annual HAPA Meeting, held in conjunction with the 2025 APA Annual Meeting.
news.body:
Dear HAPA members,

You are cordially invited to attend our Annual HAPA Meeting, held in conjunction with the 2025 APA Annual Meeting. As always the meeting takes place on the Tuesday of the APA week, from 6:00 to 8:00 PM, and is followed by a Dutch-treat dinner at a local restaurant.

news.title: APA and HAPA representatives meet the Deputy Minister of Health, Mr Dimitris Vartzopoulos
news.summary: Representatives of the American Psychiatric Association and HAPA met the Greek Deputy Minister of Health to discuss collaboration on mental health policy.
news.body: Representatives of the American Psychiatric Association and the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association met the Deputy Minister of Health, Mr Dimitris Vartzopoulos, as part of a programme of meetings across Greece on international collaboration in psychiatry.

news.title: APA and HAPA at EODY in Athens and at the University of Thessaly
news.summary: Dr P. Candilis and Dr V. Pozios of the APA, with the President of HAPA, met colleagues at EODY in Athens and at the University of Thessaly.
news.body: Representatives of the American Psychiatric Association, Dr P. Candilis and Dr V. Pozios, together with the President of the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association, met colleagues at EODY in Athens and at EODY in the University of Thessaly, to discuss public mental health, climate and community psychiatry.

news.title: Meeting with the Mayor of the Rigas Feraios Municipality
news.summary: APA representatives and the President of HAPA met the Mayor of the Rigas Feraios Municipality on community mental health provision.
news.body: The representatives of the American Psychiatric Association, Dr P. Candilis and Dr V. Pozios, and the President of the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association met the Mayor of the Rigas Feraios Municipality to discuss mental health provision in the community.

news.title: Visit to the Mental Health Centre in Volos
news.summary: APA and HAPA representatives visited the Mental Health Centre in Volos and met the hospital's director, Mr Giannis Ntokos.
news.body: Representatives of the American Psychiatric Association and the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association visited the Mental Health Centre in Volos and met the hospital's director, Mr Giannis Ntokos.

news.title: Dr Candilis at EODY's Climate Conference, Athens
news.summary: Dr Candilis delivered the opening remarks at EODY's Climate Conference in Athens on 27 May.
news.body: Dr Philip Candilis made the opening remarks at EODY's Climate Conference in Athens on 27 May, on the mental health consequences of the climate crisis.

news.title: 24th HAPA Annual Meeting, New York
news.summary: The 24th annual meeting of the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association took place on Tuesday 7 May at the New York Marriott Marquis.
news.body: The 24th annual meeting of the Hellenic American Psychiatric Association took place on Tuesday 7 May at the New York Marriott Marquis, held in conjunction with the APA Annual Meeting, and was followed by the traditional Dutch-treat dinner.

news.title: 2024 APA Meeting, New York — Presidential Session: “Models of International Collaboration for Psychiatry”
news.summary: HAPA took part in the APA Presidential Session on international collaboration in psychiatry.
news.body: HAPA took part in the APA Presidential Session on “Models of International Collaboration for Psychiatry” at the 2024 APA Annual Meeting in New York — a global research team drawing together colleagues from several countries.

news.title: Dr Philip Candilis presents anti-racism data
news.summary: Dr Philip Candilis presented anti-racism data from the HAPA collaboration with George Washington University.
news.body: Dr Philip Candilis, Immediate Past President of HAPA, presented anti-racism data drawn from the HAPA collaboration with George Washington University.

news.title: US and Hellenic psychiatry meet in Greece — 83rd Thessaloniki International Fair
